entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: IRAM's archive is browsable through its data management system, but archival data are requested by e-mail and every request is contingent on IRAM's approval; only calibrated Large Programme data are directly available. No TAP endpoint answered on 2026-09-17.
entries.revisitWhen: IRAM opens its archive to direct download, or a NOEMA dataset justifies a request to the institute.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Normal projects carry a three-year proprietary period and Large Programmes 18 months, counted from the end of the last semester of observations. No reuse licence is published; users must cite the standard IRAM reference and the observing team or programme, and IRAM states it does not support reduction of retrieved data.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: GILDAS is IRAM's reduction collection, distributed as source and binaries, with no licence file found on any of its pages.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
